We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.
To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:
Area Sales Manager
General objective of the role
As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.
Reporting lines and interactions
This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.
A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager
The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.
You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.
“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”

Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.
Qualifications
Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil. Must-Have
Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.
Your Assets
Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and CRM tools.
Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
Team-player

title: Gerente geral de propriedade em são paulo (RN)
description:
Você quer enfrentar novos desafios em uma indústria dinâmica? Você tem experiência liderando projetos onde teve que fortalecer as áreas de operações, comercial e atendimento ao cliente?
Então, essa vaga é para você!
Primeiro, nos apresentamos:
Somos a Greystar, uma empresa com um modelo de negócio focado na gestão, desenvolvimento e investimento de apartamentos para aluguer totalmente equipados, com espaços comuns acolhedores e um serviço de administração profissional que é referência no mercado.
Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base nos nossos pilares e valores; Nossos pilares nos orientam para “o que fazemos” e nossos valores norteiam “como fazemos”.
Hoje estamos em processo de crescimento no mercado brasileiro e por isso procuramos pessoas apaixonadas, dispostas a contribuir no que for necessário para alcançarmos juntos o melhor progresso.
Você pode ser nosso próximo “ Gerente de Propriedades ”
O que é ou faz um Gerente Geral de Propriedades ?
O Gerente Geral de Propriedade é uma função importante para nossas operações. É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Isto, a fim de alcançar um ótimo desempenho comercial e operacional.
Estas podem ser suas funções:

Liderar as equipes de atendimento ao cliente e manutenção.
Preparação de relatórios financeiros para nossos investidores.
Gestão de equipes, levando a promover a criação do melhor local para trabalhar.
Elaboração e gestão de orçamentos.
Gestão proativa dos índices de satisfação dos clientes: análise de informações, criação de planos, monitoramento.
Planejamento de atividades para a comunidade.
Gestão holística da manutenção predial.
Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.
Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o “know-how” pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes.
Pré-requisitos:
Carreiras com foco em Hospitality . Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...)
Experiência desejável nas áreas: Imobiliário, Multifamily, Hotelaria, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Empreendedorismo, etc...
Inglês avançado.
Utilização de ferramentas Office 365.
Se você está interessado, então o que está esperando?

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em alemanha (SE)
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .
·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .
·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Clinical application specialist em são paulo (RN)
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with Fibro Scan, the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.
Fibro Scan is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.
Echosens has made Fibro Scan available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.
Echosens is shaping the future of liver health. As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.
In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.
Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.
To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:
CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)
LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)
The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.
This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.
Main activities:
Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens Fibro Scan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise Experience / Education / Special Requirements
You have a bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.
You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.
Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.
You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.
Please submit your application and CV in English.
Why join ECHOSENS ?
Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.

Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only ﻿

title: English teacher em vitoria (RN)
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Graphic designer em aracaju (SE)
description:
Graphic Designer
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.
You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.
What you’ll do
You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
Edit video for social distribution and website use
Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.
What matters in this role
You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks
Requirements
4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
Video editing experience for social and web content
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Context for the work
Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos
Increasing engagement
Supporting sales follow-up
Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.
What this is not
Not a pure brand exploration role
Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
Not isolated design work handed over a wall
You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.
If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Graphic designer em santo andré (PB)
description:
Graphic Designer
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.
You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.
What you’ll do
You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
Edit video for social distribution and website use
Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.
What matters in this role
You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks
Requirements
4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
Video editing experience for social and web content
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Context for the work
Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos
Increasing engagement
Supporting sales follow-up
Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.
What this is not
Not a pure brand exploration role
Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
Not isolated design work handed over a wall
You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.
If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. title: Engenheiro de dados sênior em são paulo (RN)
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.
Benefícios que oferecemos:
Modelo remoto prioritário
Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
Day off no aniversário
Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind)
Acesso ao Wework

title: Marketing ai agent builder em belém (RN)
description:
Role Overview:
As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.
Core Responsibilities:
• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.
Qualifications & Skills:
• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.
• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X)
• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).
• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.

Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer em dois irmãos (RN)
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .
What You’ll Do

Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)

Experience building Kubernetes environments

Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations

Graphic Designer
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.
You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.
What you’ll do
You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
Edit video for social distribution and website use
Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.
What matters in this role
You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks
Requirements
4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
Video editing experience for social and web content
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Context for the work
Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos
Increasing engagement
Supporting sales follow-up
Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.
What this is not
Not a pure brand exploration role
Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
Not isolated design work handed over a wall
You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.
If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.

Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos

Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.

Simples Nacional

➥ Espaço para experimentação, testes e evolução profissional;

➥ Ambiente descontraído e colaborativo;
DADOS DE APOIO AO CANDIDATO
ORIENTAÇÕ ES PARA ENVIO DO CURRÍ CULO (REQUISITO OBRIGATÓ RIO)
O currículo deverá evidenciar de forma clara, objetiva e comprovável a experiência prática do candidato em rotinas fiscais complexas, com atuação direta na apuração, revisão crítica e validação de tributos em diferentes regimes tributários.
Serão considerados apenas currículos que atendam aos seguintes critérios:
1. DESCRIÇÃ O DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊ NCIA TÉ CNICA
O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante:
Nome da empresa
Período de atuação
Cargo ocupado
Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em:
Apuração de tributos (Simples Nacional, Lucro Presumido e Lucro Real)
Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais
Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária
Entregas de obrigações acessórias (SPEDs, ECF, ECD, etc.)
Conciliações fiscais e contábeis
Identificação de inconsistências, riscos fiscais e ajustes necessários
Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes
⚠️ Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática.
2. COMPROVAÇÃ O DE ATUAÇÃ O PRÁ TICA
O currículo deve deixar evidente:
Nível de autonomia na execução das rotinas fiscais
Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos
Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, volume de operações, regimes tributários)
Envolvimento em revisões técnicas, validações ou análises críticas
Atuação na identificação e tratamento de riscos fiscais
3. REFERÊ NCIAS TÉ CNICAS (OBRIGATÓ RIO)
O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica.
Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente:
Nome da empresa
Nome completo do contato
Cargo do contato
Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.)
E-mail corporativo
Telefone para contato
⚠️ As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas.
4. DIFERENCIAL RELEVANTE
Será considerado diferencial:
Experiência com empresas de maior maturidade ou complexidade tributária
Atuação em múltiplos regimes fiscais de forma simultânea
Participação na melhoria ou estruturação de processos fiscais
Experiência com análise de riscos fiscais e contingências
Vivência com planejamento tributário ou análises de impacto fiscal
Experiência com cruzamento de dados fiscais, contábeis e financeiros
Utilização de tecnologias, automações ou BI aplicados ao contexto fiscal
Inglês avançado aplicado ao contexto profissional
IMPORTANTE
Esta vaga é direcionada a profissionais com experiência prática consistente, domínio técnico das rotinas fiscais e alto nível de autonomia na execução e validação das apurações.
Não buscamos profissionais com atuação exclusivamente operacional ou com dependência constante de validação técnica.
Buscamos profissionais com capacidade de:
Analisar criticamente as apurações
Identificar riscos e inconsistências
Propor melhorias e sustentar decisões técnicas
Atuar com postura consultiva junto a clientes e equipe
Currículos que não atendam aos critérios acima poderão ser desconsiderados automaticamente.

title: Senior voip engineer em são carlos (RN)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em cabo de santo agostinho (PE)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Gerente de projeto de design em cabedelo (PB)
description:

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês). Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)
Necessário
Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX. Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Click Up, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups
Remuneração e modelo
Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer em varginha (RN)
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .
What You’ll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths” Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)
Must-Have Requirements 6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise : Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)
Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations
What We’re NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience ❌
Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
Pure security-focused candidates ❌

title: Senior voip engineer em campina grande (PB)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Lifecycle & retention strategist (klaviyo) em maracanaú (CE)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY
ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.
We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth e Commerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.
You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.
You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.
This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.
SCOPE OF WORK
Strategy and Campaign Planning
Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth e Commerce brands
Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and Click Up timelines on track
Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities Optimization and Performance
Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training Tech Stack Management and Recommendations
Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, Loyalty Lion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, After Ship), push notifications, and direct mail (Post Pilot, Paper Run, etc.)
Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team Client Collaboration
Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within e Commerce or DTC
Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
Solid understanding of the e Commerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
Proficiency with Click Up (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
HOW WE WORK
You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through Click Up for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Senior voip engineer em salto (MA)
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Content creator em frança (CE)
description:
Localização:  Remoto
Tipo:  Freelance / Contrato
Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)
Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana
Sobre o Pure
O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.
Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.
Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC
Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (Tik Tok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.
Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.
O que você vai fazer
Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (Tik Tok / Instagram Reels / You Tube Shorts, etc.)
Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
Direcionar pessoas para o app
Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais O que buscamos
Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
Familiaridade com tendências do Tik Tok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos Estrutura de pagamento
Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
Bônus por registros
Pagamentos realizados semanalmente Por que se juntar a nós
Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva Como se candidatar Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.
Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.
Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.
As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui) em jaboatão dos guararapes (PE)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:

Excel intermediário e experiência com sistemas ERP, SAP será um diferencial;

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui) em ipojuca (PE)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Proven experience in Po C execution and project delivery Ability to gather and translate customer requirements into product or technical specifications
Working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting

Experience with cloud or on-premise deployments (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Basic knowledge of SIP protocol and telephony integration
Nice to Have
Experience in BFSI, FMCG, or enterprise AI solutions
Understanding of security, compliance, and data privacy in cloud/AI environments

Carreiras com foco em Hospitality . Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...)
